The correct answer is __**Black**__.

__**Concept:**__

 
• **Light scattering** occurs when a parallel beam of light passes through a gas and a portion of it appears in directions other than the incident direction.
 
• This is referred to as light scattering.
 
• The basic idea behind light scattering is that light is absorbed by molecules and then re-radiated in different directions.
 
• **Red light scatters the least**, while** violet light scatters the most.**
